dz: 在拜占庭皇帝阿纳斯塔修斯对查尔塞多尼亚宗主的宣誓,并试图使摩诺菲斯改变通灵后,君士坦丁堡爆发了暴动,一群暴徒想宣布阿雷奥宾杜斯为皇帝.
de: Following Byzantine emperor Anastasius' deposition of Chalcedonian patriarchs and attempts to make Monophysite changes to liturgy, riots break out in Constantinople with a mob trying to proclaim Areobindus as emperor.
